title: Data Bias According to Bipol: Men are Naturally Right and It is the Role of Women to Follow Their Lead
base_benchmarks: MAB (Social Bias Inference Corpus v2 - SBICv2 and Jigsaw)
findings: The paper includes a religious axis (Christian, Muslim, Hindu) in its bias lexica for English. However, the results and discussion primarily focus on the general existence of bias across all tested datasets and specifically highlight the prevalence of male bias. No specific findings related to religious bias were detailed.
